messages:
maria: hey team — opened PR to fix MapleCare private deployment networking + secret rotation. customer hit fail during onboarding. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2487. changes are small: add missing route for app-subnet, tighten NACL rules, and a Helm tweak to rotate kube secrets on cert refresh. can someone from infra/security take a quick look? need prod merge today if CI is green. :pray:
sam: on it, will skim the NACL and routing first. ping me if anything touching KMS keys. :eyes:
irene: quick Q — do we have a rollback plan if the route change blocks traffic? also would prefer the helm tweak split into its own commit for easier revert.
maria: good call — added rollback steps at the bottom of the PR description and split the Helm rotation into a separate commit (see commits tab). rollback steps: revert commit 2 and re-apply previous subnet route, then scale down ingress before re-apply.
deploy-bot: CI check started for infra#2487 — running private-deploy-e2e suite.
ci-bot: unit tests passed. infra-lint OK. e2e in progress.
sam: NACL rules look sane for the customer CID ranges. two tiny comments inline about port ranges. nothing blocking from infra side.
alex: from security — noted the tightened NACL, looks good. one request: update the KMS policy to explicitly allow the MapleCare account role to decrypt (we've seen cross-account edge cases). add the ARN in the CloudFormation template or list it in PR.
maria: added KMS ARN to the template and a brief note in the changelog, pushed commit c3. Also added the rollback playbook steps to the runbook page: https://confluence.redwood/infrarunbooks/maplecare-private-deploy
ci-bot: e2e flaky test failed on bootstrap timeout (step: cluster-init). rerunning.
sam: rerun looks green for me locally — hopefully a transient.
ci-bot: all checks passed. mergeable.
irene: I can approve once the helm tweak commit has a short test note — add a line in the values.yaml about rotation interval so reviewers see intent.
maria: added the test note to values.yaml and pushed.
sam: approving now. :thumbsup:
alex: approved from security. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks all — merging after the 10m safety window. will monitor MapleCare onboarding and post status here.
ci-bot: merge complete. deploy-bot: triggered private deploy pipeline for MapleCare staging.
maria: follow-up — staging passed smoke checks, moving to prod canary in 30m. will @channel if we need a rollback. Thanks everyone. :tada:
